title: Implement the local development governance Monitor

requirement.summary: Continue the reviewed plan by turning privacy-bounded development governance events into an honest local Monitor that shows when governance ran and what was observed.

objective.rationale: The Monitor completes the initial Govern, Observe, Monitor product loop without moving authority into a dashboard.

goal: Generate a self-contained static Overview, Activity Timeline, and Task Detail dashboard from validated local governance events with explicit observation and claim limits.
non_goals: Do not build a central SaaS service, GitHub Pages deployment, event export, cross-machine merge, authentication, approval controls, or governance-file editing buttons.
Do not claim causal benefit, ROI, requirement correctness, architecture correctness, or complete development history.
Do not implement exported_development or combined data ingestion before the separate redacted export contract exists.
Do not add background hooks, a daemon, automatic GitHub Actions upload, commit, merge, deployment, or release behavior.
acceptance_signals: Overview, Activity Timeline, and Task Detail answer what ran, when, why, by whom, what was observed, and the latest recorded outcome within the declared observation scope.
Every dashboard displays local_session or ci_only observation scope, source interval, event count, missing sources, and observed, inferred, and unknown claim layers.
CI-only data cannot display cross-stage discovery comparisons and cannot include non-CI actors.
Invalid or conflicting duplicate events fail closed rather than silently disappearing; identical duplicates are deduplicated deterministically.
HTML is self-contained, escapes untrusted event text, performs no external requests, and contains no approval or governance mutation controls.
Default output remains untracked .agentgov local state and does not invalidate fresh evidence.

items: A dashboard could imply complete history when only local or CI events are visible.
Unescaped event metadata could create an unsafe generated HTML file.
Metrics could be mislabeled as causal effectiveness or governance approval.

stop_conditions: Stop if the Dashboard requires source content, raw validation output, credentials, absolute user paths, or external telemetry.
Stop if missing local or CI history cannot be shown honestly through observation-scope limits.
Stop if a view would turn inferred handling, effectiveness, or semantic correctness into an observed fact.
Stop if generation would overwrite a tracked or non-AgentGov-owned file without separate authority.

decision.rationale: The user explicitly directed development to continue after the Phase 3 evidence and local event core was completed. The delivered task was paused on 2026-08-05 to remove it from automatic discovery; this is routing hygiene, not a claim of semantic completion, acceptance, merge, or release.
